titulo: Early-onset blount’s disease in a two-year-old child

fig.label: Fig.1
fig.caption: Anteroposterior radiograph of both lower limbs showing bilateral genu varum with medial tibial metaphyseal beaking (spur formation) and preservation of bone density, findings consistent with early-onset Blount’s disease.
